visual_reconciliation.note: HFmrEF management: diuretics Class I, dapagliflozin/empagliflozin Class I, ACE-I/ARNI/ARB Class IIb, MRA Class IIb, beta-blocker Class IIb.
HFpEF management: diuretics Class I, treatment of aetiology and cardiovascular/non-cardiovascular comorbidities Class I, dapagliflozin/empagliflozin Class I.
Recommendation-class and level-of-evidence frameworks are summarized in the SEA methods section.
HFrEF, HFmrEF and HFpEF definitions are represented in ATOM and SEA.
All seven formal recommendation rows are represented in ATOM and SEA.
All 15 study rows were reconciled as supporting evidence. They were not promoted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms.
Used for conflict-of-interest governance appraisal. Individual expert disclosures were not atomized line by line.

omissions_and_reasons: Main-paper bibliography pages were excluded from ATOM extraction and exported separately as Markdown from the supplied evidence-table bibliography.
Underlying study results were retained as secondary-reported guideline evidence in atom_kind="other" rather than represented as primary-study quantitative_result atoms.
The 87-page declaration report was not atomized expert by expert because it is provenance and governance infrastructure rather than the clinical evidence target.
